ticket.subject: Charged twice this month
ticket.body_text:
Hi there!

We were charged twice for our Scale subscription this month: two payments of €249.00 went through on Thursday, a few minutes apart.

Our finance team flagged it during the weekly reconciliation. For reference, the payment was made with card 4111 1111 1111 1111. You can reach me on +1 415-555-0142 if a call is quicker.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Please refund the duplicate payment and confirm once it is done.

Many thanks,
Rafael Oyelaran

label_notes: pii billing (billing-double-charge): a double charge is P2 in the guide; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h; planted: card, phone, name.
